$description: Force5 design tokens. Design Tokens Format Module shape: nested groups, $type + $value per token, {dotted.path} aliases. Mode-varying tokens carry $extensions['com.multicode'].modes; $value always holds the light value so a consumer that ignores modes still renders.

ref.$description: Raw scale. Names a value, never a use. Never referenced from component CSS.

teal.$description: The one hue this product is built from (OKLab h=215deg), stepped evenly in perceptual lightness. Step 800 reproduces the historical --ink #173d49; step 400 reproduces the historical sea #83afb9.

50.$description: Lightest wash. Dialog insets and pressed-pill grounds.

100.$description: Panel ground. The opaque stand-in for the glass gradient.

200.$description: Sunken ground: table header bands, track fills.

300.$description: Hairlines and dividers at full opacity; disabled fills.

400.$description: The sea. Map ground behind the tiles.

500.$description: 3.50:1 on the panel ground. UI strokes and icons only, never text.

600.$description: 5.46:1 on the panel ground. The floor for body text and the resting action colour.

700.$description: 7.81:1. Emphasised text and the hovered action fill.

950.$description: Dark-mode page ground and the base every shadow is tinted with.

white.$description: Alpha whites. The glass language is built from these: every highlight, inner stroke and hover wash is white at some alpha, never a new hex.

a85.$description: Glass border, lit edge; the top highlight of a raised surface.

full.$description: Pure white. Text on a filled action, and nothing else.

ink.$description: Alpha inks tinted with teal.950, for shadows, scrims and hairlines. A shadow is never neutral black in this system.

a12.$description: Resting shadow of a small control.

a30.$description: Shadow of the dock and of a lifted marker.

warm.$description: The only hue family outside the teal ramp. Reserved for the now-marker and for degraded states; it is never decorative.

500.$description: Warning mark on a light ground (5.28:1 on white).

700.$description: The now-marker fill. White on it is 5.95:1.

green.$description: Liveness only: the dot that says the forecast pipeline is current.

wind.$description: THE canonical wind scale. These fourteen stops are the PALETTE in force5/src/weather.ts, which paints the map, the forecast cells and the legend. Speed bands, not safety or ability ratings. Nothing else in the system may describe wind speed with colour, and the legend gradient is generated from these stops rather than restated.

k10.$description: 10 kn. The step into rideable wind.

k30.$description: 30 kn. The top of the green band.

k65.$description: 65 kn and above. The scale is clamped here.

gradient.$description: Gradients, composed from ref colours. A gradient is never written out as a second list of stops.

wind.$description: The wind legend. Its stops ARE the PALETTE stops, positioned by knots over the clamped 0-65 range, so the legend cannot drift from what the map paints.

space.$description: A 2px-based scale. The product is dense by nature (a map with tools floating over it), so the low end is finely stepped and the high end is not.

2.$description: Optical nudge; the gap inside a tight icon pair.

12.$description: Control padding; gap between sibling controls.

40.$description: The largest gap the system offers.

radius.$description: Rounding scale. The product reads as soft glass, so the steps are large relative to the control heights.

sm.$description: Chips inside text; the now-marker label.

stroke.$description: Stroke widths. Three, and the focus ring is always the thickest.

thin.$description: Every border in the system except a focus ring or a deliberate emphasis.

medium.$description: A selected tab's underline; a dashed area outline.

thick.$description: The focus ring, and nothing else.

size.$description: Ten steps. The product renders dense numeric data over a map, so the scale starts small, but 9px is the floor and it is reserved for tracked uppercase labels.

2xs.$description: Tracked uppercase eyebrows and axis ticks. Never sentence-case prose.

2xl.$description: Place name in the forecast dock at compact widths.

4xl.$description: The wind reading at compact widths.

5xl.$description: The wind reading. The largest type in the product.

weight.$description: Five weights. The variable fonts offer half-steps; this system does not use them.

bold.$description: The selected column; the strongest emphasis available to prose.

tight.$description: Large headings, to close them up.

shadow.$description: Four elevations, all tinted with teal.950. A shadow says how far a thing floats above the map, and nothing else.

dock.$description: The edge-to-edge dock, which casts upward.

glass.$description: The backdrop blur that makes a surface read as glass.

scrim.$description: The blur behind a modal scrim.

z.$description: Nine layers. The map is the floor; the header is the ceiling. A component may not invent a value between two of these.

overlay.$description: Particles, sea labels, instructions painted over the map.

panel.$description: A panel opened from the chrome.

control.$description: Three control heights. Everything clickable is one of these; 30px is the floor, and it is only allowed where the tap target is padded by its parent.

lg.$description: Search, and the primary chrome pills.

sem.$description: Meaning. Every token here aliases a ref token and carries a role and a use. These are the only tokens a component may consume.

page.$description: The ground behind everything, seen as the sea around the tiles.

com.multicode.use: The app shell and the map panel.

glass.$description: The glass a floating surface is made of. Pairs with sem.effect.blur.glass; falls back to surface.solid where transparency is reduced or backdrop-filter is unsupported.

com.multicode.use: Panels, the dock, pills, popovers.

solid.$description: The opaque stand-in for glass. Required wherever transparency is reduced.

com.multicode.use: Reduced-transparency fallback; any surface over unpredictable content.

raised.$description: A block lifted off a surface it already sits on.

com.multicode.use: Icon-button grounds, inset definition lists, pill fills.
Sticky table headers, segmented-control trough, slider track.

inverse.$description: A surface that flips the text on it to inverse.

com.multicode.use: The active marker; a selected segment.

scrim.$description: What a modal puts between itself and the map.

com.multicode.use: Dialog backdrop.

hairline.$description: The faintest division the system draws: between rows, between a heading and its table.

com.multicode.use: Dividers inside a surface.

glass.$description: The lit edge that makes a glass surface read as an object rather than a stain.

com.multicode.use: Every glass surface's own border.

strong.$description: A border that has to be seen: a dashed area marker, a selected column edge.

com.multicode.use: Emphasised and dashed outlines.

primary.$description: Everything read at length. 10.29:1 on the panel ground.

com.multicode.use: Body, headings, the wind reading.

secondary.$description: Supporting text that is still prose. 7.81:1.

com.multicode.use: Dialog paragraphs, sub-labels that carry meaning.

muted.$description: The quietest text the system permits. 5.46:1 on the panel ground, and the floor: nothing readable is lighter than this.

com.multicode.use: Eyebrows, coordinates, ticks, captions, table metadata.

inverse.$description: Text on a filled action or an inverse surface.

com.multicode.use: Labels on action.bg, on the active marker, on the now-marker.

disabled.$description: A control that cannot be used. Paired with reduced opacity on the control itself.

com.multicode.use: Disabled labels. Never for text that is merely low priority - that is text.muted.

bg.$description: The filled action. There is one per view.

com.multicode.use: Play, and the single primary button in an error state.
Hover and active on a filled action.

fg.$description: The label on a filled action. 6.05:1 on action.bg.

com.multicode.use: Text and icons inside a filled action.

quiet.$description: An action with no fill until it is touched.

com.multicode.use: Ghost and icon buttons at rest.

quietHover.$description: The wash a quiet action picks up on hover.

com.multicode.use: Hover ground for ghost buttons and list rows.

focus.$description: The focus ring. One colour, every control, both modes.

com.multicode.use: outline on :focus-visible. Never removed, never restyled per component.
The liveness dot.

warnFg.$description: Text on a degraded state. The pair inverts wholesale in dark rather than sliding one end, so the strip keeps its contrast.

com.multicode.use: Stale-frame and fetch-failure messages.

warnBg.$description: The ground under a degraded state.

com.multicode.use: Warning status strips.

now.$description: This instant. The only warm mark on the forecast grid, which is why it is legible against fourteen wind colours.

com.multicode.use: The now line and its label. Nothing else may use warm.700.

wind.$description: The speed bands, for anything that paints a wind value: map cells, forecast cells, the legend.

com.multicode.use: Fills that encode wind speed. Identical in both modes: the scale is data, and data does not re-theme.

eyebrow.$description: Tracked uppercase label above a heading.

caption.$description: Metadata under or beside a thing.

prose.$description: Body copy read at length, away from the map.

lead.$description: Louder than body, quieter than title: the one thing a card leads with.

com.multicode.use: A listing price, a card title, a section heading. Several per view, one per card.

reading.$description: The wind speed, which is the one number the product exists to show.
